analogy.rationale: ARF (ADP-ribosylation factor) inhibitors target a poorly annotated class with no listed targets, and ARF GTPases are not among the landmark transcriptional programs; cells may show only weak, nonspecific stress responses shared with general growth-inhibitory or cytotoxic classes.
